page.overview:
What is Chameleon?

The Chameleon is a Dreadnok swamp skier that has a displacement of 673 lbs. It has a maximum speed of 62 knots and a maximum range of 203 miles.

The Chameleon can be disassembled; the front and rear skis can be removed, and the rear pair can be incorporated into the sled to further complete Zartan's disguise.
